confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on 2026-dated São Paulo sources (Expatistan, Procon-SP/Dieese, Costliving, combien-coute.net), but several figures are undated or older and neighbourhood variation is large. BRL-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 5.4 BRL per USD from background knowledge, not a searched figure. Cocktail and wine use caipirinha price ranges and a bottle price rather than a beer ratio. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; no booking pages or listings were checked. The FX value comes from RBA exchange-rate page snippets showing 16 Oct 2026, and I did not open the table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors follow direct São Paulo price points. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for São Paulo's large Brazilian city hotel and hostel market.
